ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High dominance of low-intensity pixels (dark grey/black) with sparse high-intensity (white) linear features distributed across the surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary contiguous dark-intensity regions corresponding to the lobe surfaces, interrupted by a network of high-intensity linear pixel strings and concentrated high-intensity clusters at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped bisection with an approximate 50-degree interior angle and significant bounding-box depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular jaggedness with pixel-amplitude variations of 5-12 pixels along the continuous boundary separating the fluke from the sky/water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory from the median notch transitioning into a tapering concave curve toward the acute terminal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-intensity white pixel clusters localized at the far distal tips of both lobes, suggesting previous barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of multi-directional, non-aligned high-intensity linear tracks (rake marks) spanning the majority of both visible lobe surfaces.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense distribution of linear rake marks and significant white scarring/pigment loss at the distal lobe extremities.
